findings.summary: The authoritative requirement 'fix the promoter-tick slowdown to <=+20% of base' is NOT met. Independently reproduced on real aqb-valkey (:16379), B=16, 100k entries, 3,333 hb/s: loaded/base tick ratio was 1.27 and 1.36 in 2 of 4 runs (and 1.21 at B=1). The <=+20% ratio passes only on noise-favourable runs.
findings.rule: Task text 'fix the promoter-tick slowdown to <=+20% of base (prior +26-38%) and PROVE it'; owner message #12 'slowndown arent alllowed'.

reproduction.command: cd services/queue && RUN_HEARTBEAT_LOAD=1 QUEUE_LIVENESS_SHARDS=16 TEST_VALKEY_SERVER='[{"host":"localhost","port":16379}]' go test -tags integration -run TestHeartbeatLoad -v -count=1 ./internal/queue/infrastructure/valkey/
reproduction.actual: tick_ratio logged as 0.83, 1.27, 1.36, 1.20 across four B=16 runs; 2 of 4 exceed 1.20. noop_ratio (trivial GET under same load) 0.89-1.54, so the ratio gate is physically unreachable on single-threaded Valkey. Test PASSES because it asserts an absolute (<2.5ms) + marginal (<1.2ms) criterion, not the ratio.

findings.summary: TestHeartbeatLoad no longer asserts the <=+20% ratio at all; it was redefined to an absolute-tick + marginal-sweep criterion ('option A'). The proof the task asks for ('PROVE <=+20% with the load test') does not exist as an executable gate. The redefinition is an owner/human-gate decision recorded in the ADR-030 amendment and evidence; it is honest and not a false claim, but QA cannot certify the stated numeric requirement as met.
findings.rule: Task text 'PROVE it with the load test'; QA must verify the stated requirement against evidence, not a redefined criterion.

reproduction.actual: assertions are assert.Less(duringMed, 2500us) and assert.Less(marginal, 1200us); ratio is 'logged for transparency only (gate is absolute+marginal, not ratio)'. Acceptance hinges on explicit owner ratification of option A, which is not a QA certification.

findings.summary: 'make ci green' is only valid with TEST_VALKEY_SERVER overridden to aqb-valkey :16379. The Makefile default points TEST_VALKEY_SERVER at :6379 (the forbidden shared Redis), so a bare 'make ci' would run the cover integration stage against the wrong server. The load/shard tests Fatal on :6379, but the broader cover stage does not. Pre-existing pkg/rabbitmq flake is out of scope (package untouched) and is NOT counted as a gate failure.
findings.rule: Project testing-review steering: integration tests on real project-dedicated infra; CHANGE 2 precondition 'never Redis :6379 or cluster :7000-7005'.

reproduction.actual: export TEST_VALKEY_SERVER ?= [{"host":"localhost","port":6379}] (forbidden default; must be overridden to :16379)
